articles.t: Rockstar Brings Vice City To Miami's Streets Ahead Of GTA 6 Launch - EGamers.io - P2E NFT Games Portal
articles.chapeau: Spend an afternoon on Miami Beach at the moment and the umbrella shading you could well be a Vice City one. Rockstar Games has set out Vice City-branded
articles.txt:
GTA 6 Leak Drops Two More Clips, And Vice City Keeps Getting Bigger Spend an afternoon on Miami Beach at the moment and the umbrella shading you could well be a Vice City one. Rockstar Games has set out Vice City-branded umbrellas and beach chairs along the sand, and people have also seen a promotional blimp flying over South Florida.
It’s all part of Rockstar’s campaign for Grand Theft Auto VI, which is due out on November 19, 2026. Ahead of release, the studio is dropping bits of its made-up city into the real place that inspired it. Since Vice City is based on Miami, Florida, the advertising this time looks like it was lifted straight off the game’s map.
Beyond the beach gear, there are murals, billboards and branded vehicles, along with ads for fictional businesses that exist in the game. The largest single item sits on the roof of the Kaseya Center, where the Miami Heat play: a big illuminated ‘Welcome to Vice City’ sign.
If you’ve lost hours scrolling through a garage menu, this part will land. Lookalikes of the Coquette, Cheetah, Tempesta, Emerus, Manana and Buccaneer have all been seen on Miami roads. A lineup that parks a Manana beside an Emerus is about as GTA as it gets.
Among them is a Lamborghini wearing Vice City Police livery. It’s safe to guess it’s there to be photographed and shared online, and that’s probably right.
Miami’s art scene is involved as well. Wynwood Walls has revealed 10 murals with artwork associated with GTA 6. The tie-in comes with free admission for Miami-Dade residents through 2028 and an official merchandise collection.
On November 18, the night before release, the Miami Heat will host ‘A Night in Vice City’, complete with a special court, uniforms and merchandise. Rockstar is also sponsoring a free BAYO block party in Little Haiti on November 22.
Miami is getting the bulk of the attention, though it isn’t the only city involved. In Los Angeles, a large mural of protagonists Jason and Lucia covers a wall on Hollywood Boulevard. New York City has GTA 6 ads in Times Square and a large mural in Brooklyn. Branded sightseeing buses have appeared in both New York and Chicago.
The campaign stretches past the street, too. Rockstar has announced an official GTA VI album and revealed six in-game radio stations and their hosts. Magazines, merchandise and digital platforms are part of the rollout, and Rockstar has teamed with PlayStation to promote limited-edition DualSense controllers.
Those announcements come officially from Rockstar. The street-level sightings are things people have noticed around these cities, and the most obvious one remains on the Kaseya Center roof, where the ‘Welcome to Vice City’ sign glows above downtown Miami.

articles.t: GTA 6 Fans Are Trying To Buy A Greasy Paper Bag For Over $150
articles.chapeau: Vice City fever is in full swing, as a greasy Burger Shot bag is currently being bid on for over $150.
articles.txt:
By George Foster Published Oct 25, 2026, 2:50 PM EDT George is the Lead News Editor for TheGamer, and has been working in the industry since 2021 after graduating from the University of South Wales with a bachelor's degree in Journalism. He has also previously written for RPG Site, WhatCulture, and PlayStation Lifestyle. George is an expert on platformers, action games, and fighters, but tends to play as many releases as possible. This hands-on experience lets him dive into gaming communities and follow the latest trends. Some of the games George has extensively covered first-hand include Dead Rising, Dragon Ball: Sparking Zero, Assassin's Creed Shadows, and Ninja Gaiden 4. Sign in to your TheGamer account Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s real-world promotional material, including a Cluckin Bell cup and Vice City foam fingers, are being resold for truly ridiculous prices.
As you no doubt know, we’re less than a month away from the long-awaited release of GTA 6 , undoubtedly the biggest and most-anticipated video game in the world. It took a while to get going, but Rockstar really went all-out with marketing and has basically turned real-world Miami into one big advert for Vice City .
If you’re lucky enough to be in Miami, you’ll be able to see beach chairs and umbrellas with the game’s logo , billboards referencing in-universe brands, merchandise themed around Vice City , and even buy food and drink based on chains from GTA 6. Perhaps unsurprisingly, some of these items are already being resold on eBay, and some of them really raise an eyebrow.
While GTA 6’s marketing can be found all around Miami, the Kaseya Center is home to a lot of the merchandise that fans will want , as it both sells a lot of themed clothing and temporarily houses the Burger Shot and Cluckin’ Bell restaurants. As pointed out by Twitter user iShoTz , some of those items are already making their way onto eBay.
Let’s start off with one that at least makes some sense - the Vice City foam fingers. These very basic bits of merch are clearly quite desired, as one sold on eBay for $555 , while another is currently being bid on for $300 . There’s a more reasonable listing at $81 , but I imagine that’s going to balloon up very soon.
Here’s where things get disgusting. One of the listings on eBay is for a greasy paper fry bag with the Burger Shot logo on it, which has somehow drawn 14 bids and is currently set to sell for over $150. That’s not the only gross example either, as a used Cluckin’ Bell cup is raking it in with more than 50 bids and a current price of nearly $250.
Outside of the wild hype for GTA 6, the main reason these items are going for so much is because they’re limited to Miami. If you’re from anywhere else in the world, you might pay big bucks to get a taste of that sweet, sweet marketing.
Of course, there’s a big difference between something being bid on and it actually being purchased , but it seems very likely that all of the above items will sell. Look, I’m as excited for GTA 6 as the rest of you, but if I ever get to the point that a smelly and greasy paper bag goes on my shelf, I might need a talking to.

articles.txt:
Image via Getty/Lester Cohen/NARAS Grand Theft Auto VI , believe it or not, is now roughly a month away .
Apparently, that leaves more than enough time for Daft Punk fans to pick apart an unsubstantiated claim positing that the defunct duo was initially approached about scoring the certain-to-be-incomprehensibly-successful Rockstar Games title.
In a perhaps futile effort to inject some nuance into the conversation, we're taking a closer look. Keep reading for more.

In short, the claim, stemming from a lone X post made by @hasitleaked on Monday (Oct. 19), purports that "Daft Punk's management" was presented with the idea of the duo handling the score for GTA VI , with a virtually "unlimited" budget also cited. None of this has been confirmed as of this writing, and @hasitleaked is the sole source of the claim.
Expectedly, some were quick to run with the claim, while others were just as quick to question its veracity while urging transparency in how, exactly, such alleged intel could be gleaned. Among Daft Punk fans, specifically, @hasitleaked isn't exactly a beloved institution . Notably, the duo parted ways back in 2021.
Also nothing, though Complex has contacted a former rep for the duo.
Technically, no. However, Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo, one half of Daft Punk, is a producer on Travis Scott 's "RHYNO," a new song included on the game's soundtrack .
The honor of composing the game's original score went to another beloved French duo, Justice , who recently rolled out a new GTA VI single featuring SZA, Tame Impala, and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard .

articles.chapeau: The actress who is rumored to play Lucia in Grand Theft Auto 6 surprised fans with an interactive Instagram live this weekend.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google Grand Theft Auto 6 hasn’t dropped yet and the cast is likely still under very strict NDAs, but the suspected Lucia voice actress just treated fans to a suprise Instagram live chat.
Lucia’s actress in GTA 6, Manni Perez went live for the first time on Instagram. She couldn’t properly acknowledge her role due to the NDA, but she seems just as excited as everyone else with the launch approaching. pic.twitter.com/YAPd1Y4Pwd
The team at Rockstar Games is doing its best to keep Grand Theft Auto 6 details a secret until the game arrives in mid-November. In addition to fighting back against leaks, that also includes some serious NDAs for the game’s cast.
Although the main cast members can’t open talk about the project quite yet, there are plenty of rumors about who is included. Manni Perez is rumored to play one of the game’s two main characters, Lucia, and the voice actress expanded her social media prescence this weekend with a surprise Instagram Live to connect with new fans.
The Live quickly accumulated more than 2,000 live viewers as Perez stood in her kitchen with her dog and chatted about her lifestyle, not being a millionaire, and how much she loves to cook.
As expected, tons of questions lit up the chat asking her about GTA 6 , but Perez expertly dodged all of them and kept the conversation casual and did not talk about any of her current or past acting gigs.
Perez also explained that she’s not a fan of social media, but it is required for her job. Her Instagram is not very active and only includes a small handful of posts.
Fans should keep in mind that although there have been lots of clues, Perez still has not confirmed that she is actually playing Lucia and Rockstar also has not confirmed the rumors. For now, it seems like gamers will need to wait a few more weeks until GTA 6 actually arrives to learn more about the final casting choices for the core and supporting cast.
Grand Theft Auto 6 dropped a “launch trailer” about a month out from the game’s release date, so it will be interesting to see if there is another big marketing push with new assets over the next few weeks or if Rockstar Games is just going to ride the current hype out to keep everything else a mystery.
Be sure to check back soon for lots more Grand Theft Auto 6 news and updates as the game’s release date approaches.
Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series consoles. A PC release date has not been confirmed yet.

articles.t: 30 ans d'évolution de la saga Grand Theft Auto
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 approche et la licence Grand Theft Auto se prépare à fêter ses 30 ans en 2027. Retour sur l'évolution graphique de la série.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 approche et la licence Grand Theft Auto se prépare à fêter ses 30 ans en 2027. Retour sur l’évolution graphique de la série.
Le mois prochain, GTA 6 arrivera (enfin) sur PS5 et Xbox Series X/S après de nombreuses années d’attente et 13 ans après la sortie de GTA 5 , le précédent opus de la saga. L’année prochaine, en 2027, la licence Grand Theft Auto célébrera ses 30 ans . C’est en effet en 1997 que le tout premier opus de la saga est sorti sur PC et PlayStation.
Autant dire qu’à l’époque, GTA partait de très loin. La licence a connu une évolution graphique assez impressionnante avec pas mal de changements et de révolutions. Si aujourd’hui, GTA 6 promet d’être extrêmement beau, détaillé et réaliste, cela n’a pas toujours été le cas, loin de là !
Le premier opus de la saga GTA débarque en octobre 1997, alors que Rockstar Games n’existe même pas . À cette époque, ce sont les studios BMG Interactive et DMA Design qui s’occupent de la production. Juste après la sortie du premier Grand Theft Auto , BMG Interactive est racheté par Take Two Interactive et deviendra Rockstar Games . En 2002, Take Two rachètera également DMA Design qui deviendra Rockstar North .
Pour la production du premier GTA (et des extensions GTA London 1969 et GTA London 1961 ), BMG Interactive et DMA Design utilisent un moteur de rendu fait maison qui combine des techniques 2D et 3D . C’est un moteur CPU/rastériseur créé spécifiquement par Mike Dailly et ses collaborateurs.
Le monde utilise un maillage 3D avec une caméra fixe en vue du dessus (plongée), tandis que les véhicules et les piétons sont représentés par des sprites (2D) qui changent d’échelle selon la profondeur.
En septembre 1999, Rockstar Games et DMA Design proposent une suite à GTA . Avec Grand Theft Auto 2 , nous avons le droit au premier (et seul) GTA dans le futur . Le titre se déroule en 2013 et opte pour des graphismes moins cubiques et plus arrondis . On conserve ici le même moteur graphique, qui bénéficie seulement de quelques améliorations. Ce n’est pas le jour et la nuit, mais on note tout de même quelques changements avec notamment plus de détails.
Il faudra attendre octobre 2001, le passage sur la PlayStation 2 et l’arrivée de Grand Theft Auto III pour que la licence GTA connaisse sa première révolution . Et quelle révolution ! Cette fois, Rockstar Games et DMA Design vont utiliser le moteur RenderWare , développé par Criterion Software (filiale de Criterion Games, les développeurs de Burnout ).
Grâce à ce moteur, Rockstar passe au niveau supérieur et offre un jeu intégralement en 3D. Le RenderWare est un moteur graphique et intergiciel, permettant de donner des graphismes et des API (Application Programming Interface) en 3D. Ce moteur va permettre à GTA de prendre énormément d’ampleur en offrant de meilleurs graphismes, mais aussi un gameplay plus profond.
Le jeu offrira une immersion sans précédent avec une ville de Liberty City, inspirée de New York, plus réelle que jamais.
C’est en partant sur les bases du RenderWare sur GTA III que Rockstar Games et, désormais, Rockstar North, vont réaliser un véritable exploit en moins d’un an. En octobre 2002 sort GTA Vice City qui va littéralement surclasser (et de loin) GTA III . Les équipes ont simplement amélioré et optimisés le moteur RenderWare, mais le résultat est si impressionnant qu’on avait clairement l’impression de voir un tout nouveau jeu .
C’est grâce à un travail remarquable au niveau des éclairages, de l’ambiance du jeu, et de la météo que GTA Vice City va offrir aux joueurs un rendu si différent. Là où GTA III et sa ville de Liberty City paraissait triste, grisâtre, très sombre… GTA Vice City (avec sa ville inspirée de Miami) offre des couleurs flashys, des couchers de soleil sublimes, des néons éclatants à la tombée de la nuit.
Deux ans plus tard, en octobre 2004, Rockstar Games et Rockstar North dévoilent GTA San Andreas . Et, c’est une nouvelle prouesse. Cette fois, le moteur RenderWare est poussé à ses limites . Le titre est gargantuesque avec trois grandes villes, des forêts, des campagnes, un gigantesque désert. Le jeu offre une distance d’affichage bluffante sur PS2, avec une énorme diversité dans ses paysages et ses villes.
Autre point remarquable, c’est le contenu du jeu et comment Rockstar est parvenu à faire tenir tout cela sur un disque en 2004. Le gameplay est également amélioré avec plus de détails, comme la possibilité d’escalader des murs, de faire du parkour. Il y a beaucoup plus de véhicules. En

articles.t: 'A Lot of People Want to Get to Know Me' — GTA 6 Fans Swarm Rumored Lucia Actress Manni L. Perez's Livestream
articles.chapeau: Manni L. Perez, the actress long rumored to be playing Lucia in GTA 6, has gone viral after dodging a swarm of comments from Grand Theft Auto fans during a recent livestream.
articles.txt:
Manni L. Perez, the actress long rumored to be playing Lucia in GTA 6 , has gone viral after dodging a swarm of comments from Grand Theft Auto fans during a recent livestream.
Rockstar Games has refrained from confirming the vast majority of the cast of next month's new GTA game, but as if there was ever any doubt, that hasn't stopped ravenous fans from piecing a list together themselves. Perez is one name theorists have talked about for years, so she took a few minutes to let thousands of viewers get to know her while masterfully dodging a swarm of GTA 6 comments along the way.
Reaching a peak of more than 2,100 viewers on a six-month-old Instagram account with just nine posts, Perez spent her 12-minute livestream just talking about her life growing up in a "small, rural, redneck-y" town. She lives in a studio apartment with a dog, loves to cook, grew up driving trucks, and as far as everyone else is officially concerned, she definitely will not be the star of the so-called biggest video game of all time in a little less than a month.
"But yeah, no, I'm not rich. I'm a regular person," Perez said when responding to fans who assumed she was wealthy. "I live in a small studio apartment, which I love. I have my tiny, little itty-bitty kitchen, and it's just me and my dog. I do everything on my own, and I've done everything on my own for a very long time, and I love it, and I'm very grateful. I have a family that loves me, and I'm just feeling like I'm in a really good place, where I am in my life."
"I want a green truck," she said with a smile while ignoring the horde comments mentioning "Lucia" and "GTA 6." Some responded that, no, actually, she doesn't live alone, because she has Jason to keep her company. Others were subtler, asking if she'll be playing Rockstar's latest or if she's just "ready for next month." Despite the steady flow of responses begging her to confirm her alleged role – which would be guarded under a strict non-disclosure agreement, even if it were real – Perez only acknowledged users commenting about anything else.
Keep in mind that this all comes from years of clues gathered by fans, but Rockstar's lack of confirmation doesn't mean there's nothing to suggest Perez is playing Lucia in GTA 6. As others have highlighted , the actress has a history of live-action and voice roles. She has credits for single episodes of shows like Jessica Jones, The Blacklist, and Law & Order: Special Victims Unit. Funnily enough, she also played a blackjack dealer in Grand Theft Auto Online.
Her place in Rockstar history may be given a bump when GTA 6 launches for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S next month, November 19. If you're wondering who might be playing Lucia's partner in crime, Jason, fans have long speculated that Modern Family and Grey's Anatomy actor Dylan Rourke filled the role, but he, too, has yet to be confirmed.
Who has been confirmed, whether Rockstar and any likely NDAs like it or not, is Stephen Root, who said he will be seen playing drug trafficker Brian Heder . Otherwise, we might need to wait until launch to see the full cast, so don't go sending messages to any actors just yet.
Fans may have tracked down the voice actors behind one of the biggest game launches of all time, but it's par for the course when it comes to Grand Theft Auto players. One fan spent three months charting planetary positions just to try and learn when trailer 3 would premiere (they were wrong). Another fan measured oxygen levels to try and achieve the same feat (they, too, were wrong).
Either way, GTA 6 marketing is continuing to ramp up . While we wait these last few precious weeks, you can see why some fans are expecting a sweep at The Game Awards 2026 . You can also learn more about the love and care Rockstar put into its new video game , but don't forget to read up on IGN's interview .

articles.t: Sorties jeux vidéo de novembre 2026 : les dates à retenir, de WoW Forever à GTA 6
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 sort le 19 novembre, deux semaines après WoW Forever et Zelda Ocarina of Time. Metaphor: ReFantazio et Pikmin 4 arrivent sur Switch 2 entre les deux.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 sort le jeudi 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series. Avant lui, Blizzard ouvre World of Warcraft: Forever dans la nuit du 4 au 5 novembre , Nintendo ressort Zelda: Ocarina of Time sur Switch 2 le jeudi 5, puis la console accueille Metaphor: ReFantazio et Pikmin 4 une semaine plus tard. Le reste du mois aligne surtout des remasters, des portages et des extensions, loin de la densité d' un mois d'octobre où Gears of War: E-Day, Modern Warfare 4 et Phantom Blade Zero se suivaient. Toutes les dates sont celles de la sortie en France.
L'édition Standard de Grand Theft Auto VI coûte 79,99 euros. L'Ultimate, à 99,99 euros, n'existe qu'en numérique. Les précommandes donnent droit au pré-téléchargement dès le jeudi 12, boîtes comprises, puisque celles-ci contiennent un code et pas de disque. Les fiches françaises du PlayStation Store et du Microsoft Store indiquent un déblocage à minuit, dans la nuit du mercredi 18 au jeudi 19, un horaire que Rockstar n'a pas confirmé.
Le jeu sort sans mode en ligne ni version PC annoncée . Selon Insider Gaming, les tests paraîtront avant la sortie ; Rockstar avait levé l'embargo la veille pour GTA V puis pour Red Dead Redemption 2 .
Les serveurs de World of Warcraft: Forever s'ouvrent à minuit, heure de Paris, soit le mercredi 4 au soir en Amérique du Nord. Ce troisième WoW repart de l'Azeroth de 2004 avec trois nouvelles zones, dont le mont Hyjal, plus de mille quêtes et neuf donjons inédits, pour un niveau maximum fixé à 60. L'abonnement habituel suffit pour y jouer. Les Éolides, la nouvelle race, se débloquent avec l'un des trois packs vendus par Blizzard.
Le jeu supprime le choix du royaume. On choisit une région, puis l'un des quatre modes ouverts au lancement (Normal, JcJ, JdR ou JdR-JcJ), le Hardcore arrivant plus tard. Pour jouer dans un autre mode de jeu , il faut créer un nouveau personnage ; seuls les héros morts en Hardcore pourront être transférés. Les premiers raids n'ouvriront que le 9 décembre.
Nintendo fête les 40 ans de Zelda avec le remake de The Legend of Zelda : Ocarina of Time , exclusif à la Switch 2, à 59,99 euros en téléchargement et 69,99 euros en boîte sur le Nintendo Store. Le jeu de 1998 garde ses donjons à leur place. Link peut désormais sprinter et la touche X sert à sauter. Le jeu affiche une mini-carte et tourne à 60 images par seconde. La plaine d'Hyrule a été redessinée. VGC, Nintendo Life et Eurogamer sont sortis conquis des premières prises en main , même si Nintendo Life regrette que Navi commente encore le décor, désormais par écrit.
Le même jour, la Switch 2 reçoit deux portages. Stellar Blade Complete Edition sort à 16 h en France, à 59,99 euros, avec les extensions NieR:Automata et Nikke sur une cartouche qui contient tout le jeu ; Shift Up offre en même temps quatre tenues inspirées de Bayonetta sur Switch 2, PS5 et PC. Marvel 's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition remplace la version Switch en streaming de 2021 par un vrai portage, en 1440p à 30 images par seconde ou 1080p à 40 images par seconde sur téléviseur, avec des tenues glam rock pour les cinq Gardiens.
Atlus porte Metaphor: ReFantazio sur Switch 2, deux ans après sa sortie sur PS5, Xbox Series et PC. Le RPG de l'équipe de Persona, couronné de trois prix aux Game Awards 2024, coûte 39,99 euros sur l'eShop, moins cher qu'à sa sortie. La sauvegarde de la démo gratuite passe dans le jeu complet. L'édition en boîte n'est qu'une carte clé de jeu, qui impose un téléchargement.
Pikmin 4 reçoit le même jour sa Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, vendue seule ou en mise à niveau payante pour les possesseurs de la version Switch. Elle ajoute l'Académie Dandori, 72 épreuves publiées au rythme de six par mois, avec un examen chaque week-end et des classements en ligne. Oatchi y obéit aussi à la voix, par le micro de la console.

articles.chapeau: Madeleine de prout
articles.txt:
Dans les années 2000, il était encore de coutume d'avoir des jeux vidéo adaptés des films qui sortaient au cinoche. Des productions souvent foireuses pour un tas de raisons : peu de budget, des temps de développement ultra-serrés et, souvent, l'impossibilité pour les développeurs d'avoir accès au matériau d'origine, un comble quand on doit traduire une œuvre d'un médium à un autre. De purs produits de commande, parfois bâclés, parfois (rarement) réussis, déversés par dizaines dans le paysage vidéoludique.
Shrek 2 : The Game , sorti en 2004, faisait donc partie des chantiers ordonnés par Dreamworks, qui s'en est allé voir Activision pour faire du nouveau film d'animation un jeu vidéo. C'est finalement le studio Luxoflux qui écopait de la patate chaude dans une époque où l'ogre vert épousait pleinement son statut de vedette hollywoodienne, avec la promesse d'une généreuse masse de billets tout aussi verts que son épiderme. Pour autant, est-ce que Shrek 2 faisait partie des rares bonnes adaptations de l'époque ? Disons que c'était… OK.
Chez Gamekult, le titre recevait un 5/10 : pas d'éloges donc, mais toutefois quelques encouragements pour un jeu de plateforme et d'action qui avait de bonnes idées, doublées d'un multijoueur amusant. En réalité, c'est surtout du côté du public que Shrek 2 a marqué les esprits. Les enfants qui y jouaient à l'époque sont aujourd'hui adultes et, la nostalgie aidant, figurez-vous que le titre dispose d'une excellente réputation. Et puis, surtout, Shrek lui-même n'a pas perdu de sa superbe : en être fan, c'est hype, il y a des Shrek raves partout dans le monde et c'est un sujet délibérément populaire sur les réseaux sociaux.
Pour autant, rien ne pouvait prédire le retour de Shrek 2 dans une version remasterisée : le projet vient pourtant d'être officialisé il y a quelques jours (d'ailleurs juste après une petite fuite sur le Xbox Store) et c'est donc Aspyr, qui commence à toucher sa bille en matière de portage, qui livrera cette nouvelle version éditée par Saber Interactive le 10 novembre 2026 sur PC, PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 et Switch 2.
Vous noterez aussi que le 10 novembre, c'est seulement huit jours avant GTA 6 , un créneau que l'entièreté du jeu vidéo tente pourtant d'esquiver. Le début de la bande-annonce surfe donc directement sur la tendance de Vice City, se maquillant en Grand Theft Auto , charte graphique et musique à l'appui, avant de se dévoiler pour de bon. Bien vu.
Shrek 2 : Remastered tentera de faire les choses bien avec des graphismes améliorés : de meilleures textures, une interface retouchée et de la 4K sont promises. Il proposera aussi de nouvelles fonctionnalités comme un mode Photo ou un mode Triche, tandis le multijoueur sera bien présent avec de la coopération jusqu'à quatre en local comme en ligne. Si vous jetez un œil aux réseaux sociaux, vous verrez que l'annonce a eu l'effet d'une petite bombe avec des scores assez vertigineux et des partages un peu partout. On se retrouve donc avec du Shrek d'un côté et du GTA 6 de l'autre, un duel improbable, bien qu'extrêmement momentané.
Si vous souhaitez vous faire un trip nostalgique, vous n'aurez donc pas bien longtemps à attendre : au passage, Shrek 5 sortira au cinéma le 30 juin 2027.

Circana Analyst Disputes Bloomberg Claim That GTA 6 Fueled PS5 Sales Surge | GTA BOOM
articles.chapeau: Circana analyst Mat Piscatella disputes Bloomberg, saying Marvel's Wolverine likely drove PS5's September sales jump more than GTA 6 hype.
articles.txt:
As it turns out, Grand Theft Auto VI may not be the reason for every PlayStation 5 sales surge.
According to Circana, PlayStation 5 unit sales in the United States rose 22% year over year in September, hardware revenue climbed 43% and that made Sony the highest-earning console maker of the month. Price increases over the past year and the popularity of the beefed-up PS5 Pro pushed the revenue even higher than the unit numbers alone.
Bloomberg tied the surge to consumers getting ready for GTA 6 , which isn't unreasonable considering how close we are to the game's launch.
The game costs $80 , it needs a current console to run and millions of people have waited over a decade for it, so buying a PS5 now to be ready for November 19 is the kind of early purchase that shows up in September data. However, Circana analyst Mat Piscatella is not convinced of the report .
On Bluesky he said the weekly sales data points elsewhere, "the data suggest to me that Marvel's Wolverine was the primary driver of the PS5 increase in September, with both NBA 2K27 and Grand Theft Auto VI likely playing roles." Marvel's Wolverine launched as a PS5 console exclusive that month, so a hardware bump around it makes sense on its own.
Piscatella asks, why did Xbox Series sales fall 27% in the same month, when the game is coming to Xbox too. "So either GTA was not the reason for the PS5 bump, or people don't know it's also coming out on Xbox Series," he wrote.
Circana data, with GTA 6 likely only one of several drivers rather than the whole story.
For the record, GTA 6 runs on both PS5 and Xbox Series X and S , with no PC version at launch . Anyone buying a console purely for the game has a real choice between the two. Rockstar's PlayStation-first marketing may indeed be steering that choice toward Sony.
Of course, if you ask Xbox executives , this isn't necessarily the case and the next Grand Theft Auto is selling really well on the Xbox platform as well and this Grandma is proof that not everyone who wants to play GTA 6 ends up getting an Xbox.
With that said, we can't simply ignore the possibility that, as we've already mentioned, people may have bought a PS5 or PS5 Pro because of the marketing run for GTA 6 .
Rockstar Games has said GTA 6 plays best on PS5 , the launch trailer opens on the PlayStation logo and the "best on PS5" line is all over the marketing. It is easy to picture a casual buyer walking into a store sure that GTA 6 only runs on a PS5. Sony did not get its logo on that trailer by chance, platform holders pay well to be the face of a launch this size.
So, which is which? Well, GTA 6 is clearly part of why PS5 revenue is climbing, but Marvel's Wolverine , NBA 2K27 and a year of price changes all share the credit. The real test comes in November , when the game is out and we have the launch-month numbers . We'll find out then what it truly does to console sales.

articles.t: GTA 6 : sur quelle console y jouer, PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X ou Series S ?
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 sort le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, sans écart technique annoncé. La PS5 classique reste le choix le plus sûr pour qui doit s'équiper.
articles.txt:
Pour jouer à GTA 6 le 19 novembre, il faut une PS5 ou une Xbox Series X|S : le jeu ne sort ni sur PS4, ni sur Xbox One, ni sur Switch 2, ni sur PC, où Microsoft a exclu le streaming au lancement . Rockstar n'a annoncé aucune différence technique entre la PS5 et la Xbox Series X ; rien ne justifie de passer de l'une à l'autre. Pour qui doit s'équiper, la PS5 classique coûte 150 euros de moins qu'une Xbox Series X. La PS5 Pro ne promet rien de précis et Rockstar n'a encore rien montré de la Series S, la moins puissante des quatre.
Prix, éditions, bonus et pré-téléchargement, identiques sur toutes les consoles, sont détaillés dans notre guide de GTA 6 .
La deuxième bande-annonce, l'Extended Look et la bande-annonce de lancement ont tous été capturés en jeu sur PlayStation 5, selon Rockstar. Sur les 27 minutes de jeu de l'Extended Look, filmées sur une PS5 de base, Digital Foundry a mesuré une image calculée en 1440p puis agrandie en 4K, à 30 images par seconde. La bande-annonce de lancement, sortie en octobre, présente des couleurs plus chaudes. Des joueurs y ont vu un downgrade graphique ; nos comparaisons montrent surtout des scènes filmées à d'autres heures de la journée.
Sur la fréquence d'images, la seule déclaration du studio vient de Rob Nelson, codirecteur de Rockstar North, qui a expliqué fin août que le jeu tournait « pour l'instant » à 30 images par seconde sur PS5. Il devait encore consulter son équipe technique pour savoir si un mode à 60 images par seconde arriverait au lancement ou plus tard ; Digital Foundry juge ce mode « extrêmement improbable » sur console. Rockstar n'a rien dit de la version Xbox Series X. Faute d'images captées sur la console de Microsoft, Pure Xbox, qui relayait l'analyse de Digital Foundry, attend un résultat similaire à celui de la PS5. Les deux machines reposent sur des puces AMD de la même génération, d'une puissance voisine.
Rockstar a déjà sorti sur Xbox une version plus fine que sur PlayStation. En 2018, Red Dead Redemption 2 s'affichait en 4K native sur Xbox One X quand la PS4 Pro se contentait d'une résolution inférieure agrandie en 4K, d'après Digital Foundry. Ce précédent ne dit rien de GTA 6 .
Jeuxvideo.com a titré le 22 octobre que GTA 6 « doit être plus beau sur Xbox alors que 74 % des ventes sont sur PS5 d'après les précommandes ». Les 74 % sont une estimation de Sensor Tower. Sur les 6,45 millions de précommandes numériques que le cabinet comptait au 20 octobre, 4,8 millions passaient par le PlayStation Store et 1,66 million par la boutique Xbox, comme nous le détaillions dans notre article sur les estimations de Sensor Tower . Les boîtes vendues en magasin échappent à ce comptage. Take-Two n'a confirmé aucun de ces chiffres.
La promesse d'une version Xbox plus belle n'a, elle, aucune source chez Rockstar. Elle repose sur une annonce d'AMD faite le 20 octobre. Le fabricant prépare l'arrivée de FSR 4.1, sa technique d'agrandissement d'image, sur les Xbox Series S et X. Scott Van Vliet, directeur technique de Xbox, l'a dite « bientôt » disponible sur ces consoles, sans donner de date. Ni AMD, ni Microsoft, ni Rockstar n'ont cité GTA 6 à cette occasion. Rien n'indique donc que le jeu l'utilisera le 19 novembre. Fin septembre, Matthew Ball, directeur de la stratégie de Xbox, répondait déjà que la part de Microsoft dans ces précommandes suivait sa part du marché des consoles.
La fiche de GTA 6 sur le PlayStation Store porte la mention « PS5 Pro Enhanced » . Sony l'accorde aux jeux qui tirent parti de la console, mais ni Sony ni Rockstar n'ont dit ce qu'elle recouvre ici, qu'il s'agisse d'une image plus fine, d'un ray tracing plus poussé ou d'une fréquence plus élevée. Le processeur de la PS5 Pro est presque identique à celui de la PS5 de base, si bien qu'un éventuel gain portera plus probablement sur la finesse de l'image que sur la fluidité.
Affichée à 899,99 euros en France, soit 300 euros de plus qu'une PS5 sans lecteur, la PS5 Pro est en rupture chez Sony et ne se vend plus qu'à prix fort chez les vendeurs tiers. Au Japon, Sony réserve sa vente aux joueurs qui justifient soixante heures de jeu sur deux ans, avec un tirage au sort si les demandes dépassent le stock.
Rockstar annonce GTA 6 sur « Xbox Series X|S », ce qui inclut la petite console de Microsoft. Le studio n'a montré aucune image de cette version et n'a rien dit de sa résolution. La Series S dispose de 10 Go de mémoire contre 16 Go pour la PS5 et la Series X, avec une puce graphique nettement moins puissan

articles.t: GTA 6 Just Got an Ad Spot on Druski's Show, Ali G and All | GTA BOOM
articles.chapeau: Rockstar paid to sponsor Druski's comedy show Coulda Been Records, with an Ali G sketch plugging GTA 6 preorders.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games is eating and leaving no crumbs with Grand Theft Auto VI marketing these days as it leaves virtually no marketing channel untouched. One of its latest uncharacteristic paid ads is the latest episode of Druski's Coulda Been Records. It is an OLD HEADS audition special hosted with Ali G, the Sacha Baron Cohen character, presented by GTA 6 and the latest thing anyone expected Rockstar to spend ad money on.
The integration is not subtle at all. About halfway through, the show cuts to a sponsor read:
This episode of Coulda Been Records auditions is presented by Grand Theft Auto 6 from Rockstar Games. Coming November 19th, pre-order the Ultimate Edition now on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X or S.
The video description repeats the plug with the official pre-order link for the Ultimate Edition. Beyond paying for the spot, Rockstar has said nothing about it.
Every move reaches an audience a standard game trailer would miss.
Druski is one of the biggest comedians on the internet and Coulda Been Records, his record-label parody series, regularly draws millions of views an episode with guests from music and comedy. Its mainstream, young, culture-first audience does not usually overlap with the gaming side of YouTube, which is the crowd a game this size wants to reach. Dropping Ali G into the sketch guarantees their eyes are on GTA 6 .
This is not how Rockstar normally works. The studio has spent years letting Grand Theft Auto market itself, with trailers that break the internet and a release date that clears the calendar for everyone else . Buying a slot on a comedy YouTube series is the exact opposite of this, paying to reach people who might not watch gaming channels often. The Ali G pairing fits the game's sense of humor too, since Sacha Baron Cohen built a career on the same satirical streak that runs through the DNA of every GTA .
It also fits the plan Take-Two Interactive laid out. GTA 6 's marketing has indeed been the shortest and most intense in the series , built on what CEO Strauss Zelnick called a campaign that "reflects where audiences and attention is today." He promised something unlike the long rollout for Grand Theft Auto V , with more influencer partnerships and creator-native content. A sponsored comedy episode is that promise in practice, meeting people where they already are instead of waiting for them to come to a trailer.
The sponsorship is one piece of a bigger push. Rockstar is courting creator crews like the Vanoss gang ahead of launch, it turned the Miami Heat into Vice City for a night and it even let Zelnick tease the game through a Netflix appearance . Comedy YouTube, basketball, streaming TV, creators in Miami, none of it is a traditional game ad and all of it is deliberate.
The intensity is the point. Rockstar is running this campaign in roughly five months, against the nearly two years it spent selling the last game. Compressing the timeline means every move has to hit harder and reach wider. Podcasts and comedy shows are some of the most-watched and most popular content on the internet right now. Almost no blockbuster game has tapped them like this.
Ultimately, the takeaway here is that Rockstar has decided the best place to sell GTA 6 is wherever people are already laughing, scrolling or watching.
With under a month to go , expect the surprises to keep coming from stranger and stranger places.

La sortie de GTA 6 approche et les joueurs peuvent déjà préparer leurs consoles pour profiter du jeu dès son lancement. Entre le préchargement, l’espace de stockage nécessaire, les horaires de déblocage et les risques de spoilers, plusieurs détails méritent d’être anticipés avant de retourner à Vice City.
Rockstar Games a confirmé la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI pour le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S. Le préchargement des versions numériques doit commencer le 12 novembre, soit une semaine avant le lancement. Voici les informations essentielles et les conseils à suivre pour être prêt le jour J. Pour beaucoup, cette préparation inclut aussi la question de Argent GTA 6 et de la progression dans le futur multijoueur.
Rockstar Games a confirmé que les joueurs ayant précommandé la version numérique pourront commencer à télécharger GTA 6 le 12 novembre 2026. Le jeu sera ainsi installé à l’avance, mais restera verrouillé jusqu’à son déblocage officiel.
Les éditions physiques proposées sous la forme d’un code dans une boîte seront également disponibles à partir du 12 novembre pour permettre le préchargement. Attention toutefois : cette version ne contient pas de disque physique. Elle comprend un code permettant de télécharger le jeu.
Précommandez la version numérique ou récupérez le code de votre édition physique.
Lancez le téléchargement dès que le préchargement devient disponible.
Vérifiez que l’installation est terminée avant le 19 novembre.
Laissez suffisamment d’espace libre pour le jeu et ses éventuelles mises à jour.
La taille définitive du téléchargement doit être vérifiée sur les boutiques officielles. En attendant une confirmation précise, mieux vaut libérer de l’espace supplémentaire plutôt que d’attendre le dernier moment.
L’espace disponible varie selon la console et les jeux déjà installés. À titre indicatif, le matériau de départ estime l’espace utilisable à environ 667 Go sur la PS5 d’origine, 364 Go sur la Xbox Series S de 512 Go et un peu plus de 800 Go sur la Xbox Series X.
Ces chiffres correspondent à des estimations de capacité disponible, et non à la taille de GTA 6. La taille finale du jeu n’étant pas confirmée dans les informations citées, évitez de désinstaller des jeux au hasard avant de connaître les besoins exacts.
Sur PS5, pensez également à vérifier les mises à jour système disponibles. Il est préférable de préparer la console à l’avance plutôt que de devoir installer une mise à jour au moment du lancement.
La date de sortie officielle est fixée au 19 novembre 2026. En revanche, Rockstar n’a pas confirmé publiquement un horaire mondial précis de déblocage. Les horaires affichés sur certaines boutiques, notamment le PlayStation Store, indiquent un lancement à minuit selon l’heure locale de chaque région.
Si ce calendrier est maintenu, les joueurs de certaines régions pourront commencer à jouer alors que le 18 novembre sera encore en cours dans d’autres pays.

États-Unis, côte Est : minuit le 19 novembre, soit 23 h le 18 novembre dans le fuseau central et 21 h sur la côte Ouest.
Ces horaires doivent être considérés comme des indications issues des boutiques, et non comme une confirmation définitive de Rockstar. Consultez la fiche de GTA 6 sur la boutique de votre plateforme à l’approche du lancement pour vérifier l’heure applicable à votre région.

Cette méthode n’est toutefois pas aussi simple qu’un simple changement d’horloge. Les règles des boutiques, les moyens de paiement et les conditions applicables aux comptes peuvent limiter les possibilités. Vérifiez les conditions officielles de votre plateforme avant d’acheter le jeu une seconde fois.

articles.t: GTA 6 Weapon System: Weapon Limits, Gunplay Changes, and Confirmed Weapons
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 introduces a more realistic and tactical weapon system, featuring a four-weapon carrying limit, vehicle-based weapon storage, improved police behavior, and an upgraded weapon wheel. With diverse confirmed firearms, non-lethal combat options, and more reactive NPCs, these changes aim to make combat more strategic and immersive than in GTA V.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 introduces a more realistic and tactical weapon system, featuring a four-weapon carrying limit, vehicle-based weapon storage, improved police behavior, and an upgraded weapon wheel. With diverse confirmed firearms, non-lethal combat options, and more reactive NPCs, these changes aim to make combat more strategic and immersive than in GTA V. Players looking to prepare for the game's economy and progression can also explore options to buy GTA 6 Money as they plan their in-game purchases and equipment.
One of the biggest changes is the restriction on how many weapons players can carry. Instead of carrying an extensive arsenal like in GTA V, players can reportedly equip two handguns and two long guns at a time.
Handguns remain concealed, while long guns can be visibly carried over a character's shoulder or in their hands. This makes weapon selection more important, particularly when preparing for missions or unexpected encounters.
Players who need additional equipment must store their extra weapons in the trunk of their personal vehicle. By contacting a mechanic or requesting their vehicle, they can retrieve different weapons when necessary. This system resembles the weapon storage mechanic in Red Dead Redemption 2 and encourages more deliberate preparation.
Weapons collected from NPCs can also provide temporary alternatives during combat, giving players additional flexibility when their preferred equipment is unavailable.
GTA 6 changes how arrests affect weapon ownership. Weapons purchased by players can be recovered after an arrest, while weapons picked up during combat are confiscated. Players can retrieve their own equipment from their vehicle's trunk or an Ammu-Nation locker.
Minor crimes may also lead to arrest attempts rather than immediate gunfire. If police successfully detain a character, the character is taken to a police facility, loses some money, and must recover their weapons afterward. Dying, meanwhile, results in a hospital respawn.
The wanted system also emphasizes witnesses and evidence. NPCs can call the police, alarms can trigger emergency responses, and officers may radio for backup. Preventing a witness or officer from reporting a crime could help players avoid attracting police attention, although the precise mechanics remain subject to confirmation.
The familiar weapon wheel returns with a modernized interface featuring separate weapon and item tabs. Players can quickly access firearms, utility equipment, medical supplies, and body armor.
Two recovery items add another layer to combat. The Zombi restores health, while the EpiPen replenishes Focus, an ability that helps players identify threats, escape routes, police positions, and enemy weaknesses.
Combat feedback has also evolved. Different hit markers distinguish ordinary hits, non-lethal injuries, and lethal shots. Players may be able to disarm enemies, target their limbs, or intimidate opponents without killing them. These choices could influence the character's criminal profile.
Dual-wielding will reportedly not be available, but switching shooting hands can provide tactical advantages when clearing buildings. Players can also use weapons underwater and fire from vehicles in certain situations.
Rockstar's promotional materials have revealed a diverse collection of firearms and melee weapons.
Girardi ES9, Klose K17, Morning Revolver, Nipper 38, Stun Gun

Baseball bat, crowbar, hunting knife, brass knuckles, hammer, golf club
This list covers weapons identified in promotional material, but the final arsenal may include additional equipment. Weapon customization has also been showcased through special designs, although the complete modification system has not been explained.
Carrying a firearm openly can influence how NPCs behave. In crowded areas, Jason and Lucia may conceal their weapons automatically, while nearby civilians can react with fear or move away.
Ammu-Nation is also expected to return as a major weapon retailer. Some weapons may be available only at particular locations, encouraging players to explore different parts of the map. However, the extent of regional weapon availability and customization options remains unconfirmed.
First-person mode has not been officially confirmed for launch, so its availability should not be assumed.

L’affaire Cyberleek n’est peut-être pas terminée. Après avoir annoncé le 14 octobre dernier mettre fin à ses divulgations concernant GTA 6, le mystérieux auteur ou collectif semble avoir changé d’avis.
Un communiqué intitulé “ RETURN OF CL “, daté du 21 octobre, est apparu sur le site associé à ses précédentes publications. Le message promet un retour particulièrement offensif, avec de nouvelles révélations dont la nature reste inconnue.
Cette annonce intervient à moins d’un mois de la sortie du jeu. Le titre est attendu le 19 novembre 2026.
Cette affaire est étrange car rappelons que le 14 octobre dernier Cyberleek avait pourtant annoncé abandonner son projet de diffuser une prétendue version complète de GTA 6 . Son objectif financier, fixé à 30 millions de dollars de capitalisation pour sa cryptomonnaie, n’avait pas été atteint.
Dans son message de départ, il affirmait également renoncer à dévoiler la conclusion de l’histoire.
Mais tout vient de changer. Le nouveau communiqué annonce son retour et promet que les prochaines révélations seront détaillées.
Malgré cette déclaration, nous n’avons pas identifié de nouvelle séquence de gameplay pouvant être authentifiée indépendamment. Le site associé à Cyberleek continue de présenter les précédentes publications, notamment celles du 14 octobre.
Il faut également rappeler que plusieurs sites utilisent désormais le nom Cyberleek pour proposer de prétendues versions jouables contre paiement. Dans un tel contexte il est fortement recommandé d’étre très prudent.
Pour revenir à l’affaire de Cyberleek, elle est à surveiller car ce nom est à l’origine de la publication de plusieurs séquences attribuées à des versions de développement de GTA 6. Certaines ont été examinées par des médias spécialisés qui ont jugé que l’authenticité était probable.
Son éventuel retour pourrait donc s’accompagne de nouvelles divulgations serieuses.

articles.txt:
Slime Miner New Update: “Quick, Survive, Profit A new leak suggests GTA 6 reviews could go live only a day before the game itself, which gives players a single day to read what critics thought. Some outlets, according to the same leak, won’t be allowed to publish until launch day.
The claim came from a forum poster called BlackBate on October 23rd. They said the review embargo for GTA 6 ends on November 18th, one day ahead of the November 19th release. Aggregate review scores should begin to show up at around 12:01-1:01 PM CET/6-7 AM EST, per the post. BlackBate added that some sites or YouTube channels might be held until 6:01 CET/12:01 AM EST on November 19th, the moment the game goes live.
Rockstar and Take-Two haven’t confirmed any of it. This is an unverified leak and should be read as one.
You probably haven’t heard of BlackBate. Since 2021, though, the poster has built up a fairly solid record. They correctly called announcements for Microsoft Flight Simulator, Death Stranding, Pragmata and Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced.
The new details also line up with what earlier GTA 6 reports said. Those reports had the embargo lifting ahead of the November 19th release, with media outlets reportedly receiving copies of the game before October was out.
The leak gives no reason for holding some outlets back until release day, and the motive isn’t obvious. One possibility is that Rockstar wants written reviews published first, so critics settle on a shared verdict early. Video reviews, which might contain story spoilers, could then follow with footage as soon as the game unlocks on the Xbox and PlayStation Store.
There’s also a plainer explanation. Rockstar may simply be putting journalists at larger publications first in line, which won’t surprise anyone who has followed the embargo schedule for a big release.
NateTheHate, a trusted insider, has leaked that Rockstar should be getting copies to the media soon. According to BlackBate, the studio still hasn’t sent out digital Xbox or PS5 codes. The poster’s sources put that either in the week of October 26th or early November.
That would give reviewers somewhere between two and three weeks in Leonida’s open world before the embargo ends. By Rockstar standards, that isn’t much time.
BlackBate also doubts there will be any hands-on previews with the clock this tight. Content creators have so far been invited to watch gameplay, and no one outside the studio has been allowed to play as Jason and Lucia.
These embargo details are still a leak and deserve some skepticism. The timing matches what Rockstar has done before, though: reviews for both Grand Theft Auto 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 arrived the day before each game launched.

articles.chapeau: Une fuite venue de ResetEra affirme que les premiers tests de GTA 6 tomberaient le 18 novembre 2026, la veille de la sortie officielle. Mais entre embargo à deux vitesses et silence de Rockstar, le calendrier cache encore quelques zones d’ombre.
articles.txt:
Une fuite venue de ResetEra affirme que les premiers tests de GTA 6 tomberaient le 18 novembre 2026, la veille de la sortie officielle. Mais entre embargo à deux vitesses et silence de Rockstar, le calendrier cache encore quelques zones d’ombre.
Les joueurs attendent la date des tests de GTA 6 presque autant que la sortie du jeu lui-même. Selon une fuite apparue le 23 octobre sur le forum ResetEra , reprise par Notebookcheck , l’embargo sur les tests de Grand Theft Auto VI se terminerait le 18 novembre 2026, soit la veille du lancement sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S .
Derrière cette fenêtre a priori idéale pour décider de garder ou non sa précommande, la rumeur cache pourtant un petit hic : un embargo à deux vitesses, accompagné d’une absence totale de preview jouable pour l’instant. Et comme Rockstar Games n’a rien confirmé officiellement, tout le calendrier doit encore être pris avec prudence.
Avant tout, rappel rapide : un embargo est une date et une heure imposées aux médias pour publier leurs tests. Aujourd’hui, Metacritic et OpenCritic affichent encore un simple « tbd » pour GTA 6 , tandis que Rockstar ne communique que sur la sortie du 19 novembre 2026 et le préchargement prévu le 12 novembre.
D’après l’initié BlackBate sur ResetEra, les premiers avis complets tomberaient le 18 novembre, avec une levée d’embargo située entre 12 h 01 et 13 h, heure de Paris. Concrètement, le Metascore de GTA 6 commencerait à apparaître en début d’après-midi chez nous, comme l’explique Notebookcheck. Ce schéma colle aux précédents GTA V et Red Dead Redemption 2 , dont les tests ont été publiés un jour avant la sortie, ce qui renforce la crédibilité de cette fenêtre sans en faire une certitude.
Le point vraiment surprenant de la fuite, c’est que tous les médias ne seraient pas logés à la même enseigne. Toujours selon BlackBate, certains sites et chaînes YouTube devraient attendre le 19 novembre à 6 h 01, heure de Paris, pour publier leurs tests ou vidéos de gameplay. Résultat : un premier cercle de rédactions écrites en avance, puis une seconde vague, plus vaste, au moment même où le jeu sortira.
Notebookcheck évoque plusieurs hypothèses : Rockstar pourrait vouloir laisser les articles écrits installer d’abord un consensus critique, les vidéos étant plus propices aux spoilers scénaristiques, ou bien privilégier quelques grands titres généralistes. Pour les joueurs qui se fient surtout aux reviews vidéo ou aux streamers, cela signifie potentiellement devoir acheter GTA 6 sans l’avis de leurs créateurs favoris.
Autre point à garder en tête : dans la courte fenêtre 12 h 01 – 13 h, Metacritic et OpenCritic n’afficheront que quelques notes issues des plus gros médias. Le score de GTA 6 risque donc de beaucoup bouger dans l’après-midi. Comme le rappelle PlanetGTA6, toute « note » qui circule sans test signé et consultable doit être considérée comme suspecte, surtout à l’approche d’un mastodonte pareil.
L’insider NateTheHate affirme que Rockstar doit envoyer les copies de test avant la fin octobre. BlackBate précise de son côté que les codes numériques PS5 et Xbox Series X|S n’étaient pas encore partis au moment de son message, mais qu’il vise la semaine du 26 octobre ou le tout début novembre. Cela laisserait environ deux à trois semaines aux testeurs pour explorer Leonida, l’immense monde ouvert de GTA 6 .
Avec ce timing, un autre hic apparaît : jusqu’ici, les journalistes et créateurs de contenu invités par Rockstar n’ont eu droit qu’à des démonstrations de gameplay jouées par les développeurs, sans prise en main réelle de Jason et Lucia . BlackBate ne s’attend pas à de vraie preview jouable avant l’envoi des copies presse, ce qui signifie que les premiers avis « manette en main » solides arriveraient précisément avec ces tests sous embargo.
Reste que tout ce calendrier ne repose que sur quelques insiders relayés par Notebookcheck, Mezha et plusieurs sites français. Rockstar Games, de son côté, n’a officialisé que la sortie du 19 novembre 2026 sur console et le préchargement du 12 novembre. La logique historique des embargos de GTA V et Red Dead Redemption 2 rend la fuite plausible, mais les plans peuvent encore changer jusqu’à la dernière minute.

articles.t: France TV diffuse un documentaire sur la création de la licence GTA (avec la participation de Rockstar Mag')
articles.chapeau: Découvrez dès maintenant un documentaire sur la création de la licence Grand Theft Auto par France TV et Galatée Films.
articles.txt:
En marge de la sortie de GTA 6, France TV prépare le terrain avec un documentaire de grande qualité, avec des intervenants prestigieux, dont Jamie King, le co-fondateur de Rockstar Games.
En mai 2025, France Télévision et la société Galatée Films ont produit un documentaire sur la création de la série Grand Theft Auto . Produit par Sonia Dauger, co-écrit par Quentin Margot, raconté par Fadily Camara, ce documentaire se concentre sur les origines de la saga et sa montée en puissance.
Au cours de l’année 2024 et 2025, nous avons eu l’opportunité de collaborer avec Galatée pour la production du documentaire en leur apportant quelques contacts et conseils . Le documentaire est disponible en avant-première sur France.tv et sur la chaîne YouTube de FranceTV / Slash Enquête depuis le 23 octobre . Il sera diffusé le 12 novembre sur France 4 en deuxième partie de soirée.
Découvrez dès maintenant un documentaire de 52 minutes sur la création de GTA. Du premier opus en 1997, par les innombrables succès, de Vice City à San Andreas , en passant par GTA 4 et GTA 5 . Comment la licence est parvenue à s’imposer comme l’une des plus puissantes de la pop culture.
Pour raconter cette histoire, France TV est allée jusqu’à Dundee, là où tout a commencé pour rencontrer Keith Hamilton, Paul Farley ou encore Gary Penn qui faisaient partie de l’équipe d’origine de GTA et GTA 2 . Ils sont allés jusqu’à New York pour rencontrer et interviewer Jamie King, le co-fondateur de Rockstar Games .
D’autres personnalités participent au documentaire, comme Naza (rappeur), Heavenfox (streameuse), Fadily Camara (comédienne), Marie Lou Dulac (experte en inclusion) ou encore Pierre Trouvé (journaliste Le Monde). J’ai également eu l’honneur et le privilège de participer et de pouvoir donner mon avis sur cette licence culte.
Retrouvez le documentaire dès aujourd’hui sur France.tv et sur la chaîne YouTube de FranceTV / Slash Enquête.
Pour ne rien manquer de l’actualité de Rockstar Games, rejoignez Rockstar Mag’ sur YouTube , X (Twitter) , Threads , Instagram , Facebook , Discord et Bluesky .

Les journalistes et les créateurs de contenu n’auraient pas non plus encore reçu de codes numériques.
articles.txt:
De précédentes fuites sur GTA 6 affirmaient que l’ embargo sur les tests serait levé avant la sortie prévue le 19 novembre . Les médias devraient également recevoir des exemplaires du titre de Rockstar avant la fin du mois d’octobre. Désormais, un internaute ayant déjà fait des prédictions exactes a indiqué quand les notes Metacritic seront publiées.
Bien que BlackBate, contributeur de ResetEra , soit peu connu, ses informations se sont progressivement révélées fiables. Depuis 2021, ce membre du forum a dévoilé à l’avance des annonces concernant Microsoft Flight Simulator , Death Stranding , Pragmata et Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced .
Le 23 octobre, BlackBate a indiqué que l’embargo sur les tests de GTA 6 serait levé le 18 novembre. Plus précisément, les notes Metacritic devraient être publiées vers 12 h 01-13 h 01 CET/6 h-7 h EST. Toutefois, certains sites ou chaînes YouTube pourraient devoir attendre jusqu’à 6 h 01 CET/0 h 01 EST le 19 novembre, jour de la sortie.
ⓘ BlackBate@ResetEra forums Fuite de l’embargo sur les tests de GTA 6 dévoilée On ne sait pas vraiment pourquoi certains médias devraient retarder leur couverture jusqu’à la date de sortie de GTA 6 . Selon une théorie, Rockstar préférerait que les articles écrits paraissent d’abord pour établir un consensus critique. Ensuite, les vidéos, susceptibles de dévoiler des éléments de l’intrigue, pourraient montrer des séquences à mesure que le jeu devient accessible sur Xbox et sur le PlayStation Store . Ou peut-être que le studio donne simplement la priorité aux journalistes des plus grands médias.
Le temps pressant, BlackBate soupçonne également que les fans ne verront pas d’ aperçus réalisés manette en main . Jusqu’à présent, les créateurs de contenu ont été invités à regarder du gameplay , mais pas à contrôler eux-mêmes Jason et Lucia .
NateTheHate, une source interne fiable, a révélé que Rockstar devrait bientôt distribuer des exemplaires aux médias. Cet utilisateur de ResetEra estime que le studio n’a pas encore envoyé les codes numériques Xbox ou PS5 . Ses sources suggèrent que cela se produira soit la semaine du 26 octobre, soit début novembre. Les testeurs pourraient disposer de 2 à 3 semaines pour explorer le monde ouvert de Leonida .
Comme pour toutes les fuites, les fans devraient prendre les détails de l’embargo sur les tests de GTA 6 avec des pincettes. Néanmoins, ces affirmations concordent avec les précédents de Grand Theft Auto 5 et de Red Dead Redemption 2 . Dans les deux cas, les critiques ont été publiées la veille de la sortie.

articles.t: Cyberleek Threatens GTA 6 Build Leak Over Discs And An Apology
articles.chapeau: Cyberleek says a GTA 6 build leak will happen at a 30M market cap unless Take-Two ships physical discs and apologises. We look at what’s actually known.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 has spent years being picked apart by leakers, and now one of them is threatening to go much further than just sharing footage. Cyberleek has said on his website that he’ll release a playable build of the game to the public once he hits 30 million in market cap, as spotted in a post on r/GamingLeaksAndRumours . This GTA 6 build leak threat comes with conditions attached, and TakeTwo is the one being asked to meet them.
It is worth noting that none of this has been verified and there’s no confirmation that Cyberleek actually has a build, and neither Rockstar nor TakeTwo has responded publicly.
Cyberleek also acknowledged that the publisher probably assumes he’s bluffing and that’s a fair assumption on TakeTwo’s part, given that he hasn’t shown anything publicly that proves he has a build to release.
The market cap part is the strangest element. Market capitalisation usually refers to the total value of a company’s shares or a cryptocurrency token, but the post doesn’t say what asset this figure applies to, what currency it’s measured in or who controls it. Without that, it’s impossible to tell how close he is to the target, or whether the whole thing’s tied to some kind of token promotion.
The physical disc condition suggests Cyberleek is positioning himself as speaking for players rather than simply holding a game to ransom. The post doesn’t explain the reasoning, though, or what TakeTwo has done that he thinks warrants an apology.
Disc ownership has been a sore point across the industry for a while. More big releases are shipping as download codes or with only part of the game on the disc, and plenty of players see a physical copy as the only version they truly own. Whether that’s what’s driving this demand isn’t clear from what’s been shared.
If Cyberleek is bluffing, he’s picked a target where leaks are easy to believe. Rockstar’s history includes the 2022 breach that put early GTA 6 development footage online, and the hacker behind that is set to go back to court just days before the game launches . Older material keeps surfacing too, with stolen GTA 5 files revealing cancelled single-player expansions .
There’s a big difference between leaking video and leaking a working build, though. Footage spoils surprises. A build in the wild could be datamined for every mission, map area and system Rockstar’s spent years developing, and it’d give cheat makers a head start before the game even goes on sale.
For anyone on PC hoping a leak means getting hands on GTA 6 early, it’s worth being sceptical. Supposed leaked builds of huge games are a common lure for malware, because people are willing to download large archives from unknown sources and run whatever’s inside.
Even if a genuine build did appear, there’s no indication of what platform it’d be for or how complete it’d be. Development builds are often unstable, unoptimised and tied to specific hardware or tools, so it’s far from guaranteed anyone could run one on a normal gaming PC.
If something does surface claiming to be GTA 6, the safest move is to leave it alone. A compromised system isn’t a fair trade for an early look at a game that’s coming anyway. For now, this looks more like an attention grab than a credible threat, especially with that unexplained market cap target attached.
Do you think Cyberleek actually has a build, or is this a bluff aimed at hype? Let’s know your thoughts in the comments.

articles.t: Cyberleek declares 'The End of the Road' for GTA VI leaks after failing to hit crypto target | GosuGamers
articles.chapeau: GTA VI leaker Cyberleeks steps back after its memecoin value collapsed.
articles.txt:
All News Cyberleeks ends GTA VI leaks "for now" as memecoin crashes (Image: Rockstar Games)
{" "} Cyberleek declares 'The End of the Road' for GTA VI leaks after failing to hit crypto target GTA VI leaker Cyberleeks steps back after its memecoin value collapsed. Cyberleek has declared the end of its notorious Grand Theft Auto (GTA) VI leak campaign after failing to reach the US$30 million market capitalisation target for its memecoin, Kotaku reported.
The anonymous entity published a three-part statement on its website, declaring the end of its leaks “for now” and suggesting that a “dead man’s switch” could release spoiler content if anyone attempts to “remove” Cyberleek.
In a post titled “End of the Road”, Cyberleek has declared an end to its leaks “for now”, as its memecoin, CYBERLEEK , reportedly crashed from a market capitalisation of US$7.8 million to US$1.7 million. This left it well short of the US$30 million target that would have led to the release of the full GTA VI build.
“The 30M was not reached, so no build,” said Cyberleek. “Uploading 200+ GB anonymously is a serious risk – worth it only if the milestone funded the secret project. Terms honoured as written.”
Cyberleek also clarified that its decision to step back from leaking content was not an act of magnanimity towards Take-Two. Instead, it claimed to be avoiding ruining the experience for gamers “who did nothing wrong”.
Cyberleek has a contingency plan, however, threatening to release the game's ending if anyone attempts to “remove” it, presumably referring to GTA VI developer Rockstar Games and its parent company, Take-Two Interactive.
“CL has the ending. It was considered. It would punish Take-Two greatly – but ruin the experience for the gamers, who did nothing wrong. Take-Two would show CL no mercy – why should CL show any to them? Still: Take-Two was punished enough. The ending stays unpublished. Proof: the latest leek – clips from the final missions, out of context, revealing nothing.”
The leaker also addressed allegations that its GTA VI leak campaign was a large-scale rug-pull scheme, denying the claims and insisting that purchases of its memecoin is meant to be a donation rather than an investment.
“CL sold twice. Both times: trading fees only, as always announced. The first sale caused a cascade: everyone else sold, and CL was blamed for the crowd’s dump. The chain is public: what CL holds, sold, and delivered. What was promised was kept. The token was always a donation, never an investment. No returns promised, none implied. Rugpull talk comes from people who never opened the chain. Mostly YouTubers. Do not trust them. They have no idea what they are talking about.”
In August, an anonymous entity known as Cyberleek began publishing leaked GTA VI content as part of a protest against Rockstar Games, demanding the release of physical discs for the game. The campaign resulted in a substantial amount of gameplay footage being circulated online, reportedly revealing everything from the Leonida map and gameplay systems to NPC interactions . More recently, footage allegedly showing protagonists Jason and Lucia naked also surfaced.
Although the authenticity of every leak has not been confirmed, Take-Two's efforts to issue DMCA takedown notices against videos containing the leaked gameplay have further fuelled speculation about their legitimacy.
Take-Two also sought assistance from US courts to obtain information from Discord, X and Google as part of its investigation into the GTA VI leaks . These efforts followed the emergence of Cyberleek's campaign.
The controversy may eventually subside as GTA VI finally approaches its scheduled release date of 19 November 2026. The game is set to launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a PC version reportedly expected in the first quarter of 2027.

articles.chapeau: A rumor claims a retired group was originally offered the opportunity to reunite to compose the score for "Grand Theft Auto 6," and some fans are heartbroken.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games Add SVG on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Rockstar Games has a pedigree for putting tremendous effort into its games' audio presentations, frequently leaning on both licensed tracks and original compositions by esteemed artists. The developer worked with acts like rock band Health for "Max Payne 3" and synth pioneers Tangerine Dream for "Grand Theft Auto V," and it seems "Grand Theft Auto VI" aims to continue the trend of creating an ambitious soundtrack for players.
"Grand Theft Auto VI" aims to continue along this path, with its score being handled by French electronic music duo Justice. However, if a leak from Twitter user HasItLeaked is to be believed, they were actually the second choice to handle the score. Rockstar's initial pick was apparently none other than Daft Punk. According to the supposed leak, the plan was to lure the duo out of retirement with the promise of an "unlimited budget" to make "GTA 6" their "final comeback."
"I wish I didn't hear this because I want it to happen so bad," one person wrote on Reddit . "I would have killed for Daft Punk to come back," wrote another.
But like all leaks and rumors, this one must be taken with a grain of salt, no matter how believable or compelling it may seem. As leakers go, user HasItLeaked has a reasonably strong track record, though they've also missed the mark here and there. Back in 2019, for instance, they claimed that Daft Punk was in the studio working on a new record for 2020, but that album never materialized.
Rockstar Games Daft Punk has always been popular, but they became mainstream "nerd culture" icons after composing the acclaimed score for the film "Tron: Legacy" back in 2010. They even got a noteworthy, if subtle, tribute in "Pokémon Scarlet and Violet" a few years back, which only boosted their geek cred. They were titans of electronic music, so it's easy to imagine why Rockstar could want them to participate in "Grand Theft Auto VI."
Justice and Daft Punk are somewhat similar in that they are both French duos specializing in electronic music. Daft Punk retired in 2021, and if anyone could have gotten Thomas Bangalter and Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo to reunite, it would have been Rockstar and its seemingly bottomless wallet. Alas, it was not to be.
It's worth noting that " Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album " features a song by Travis Scott entitled "RHYNO" that's produced by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo, so there's still some Daft Punk DNA in the game. Is it possible that "RHYNO" is the last remnant of the original plan to have Daft Punk craft the entire "GTA 6" musical soundscape? It's technically possible, but it could just as easily be a happy coincidence, or even the source of the rumor in the first place. In any case, it's probably best not to invest too much meaning in that one connection.
Rockstar Games The leak has had the unfortunate side effect of feeding the narrative that Justice is a second-rate version of Daft Punk. Fans across the more speculative corners of the internet can use this rumor to suggest that since Justice was more easily obtainable, Rockstar must have "settled" for working with them.
In real life, however, music is not a competition, but an exercise in artistic expression. Sure, Daft Punk is massively popular, and their retirement has given the duo a mythical status, but Justice is also a fantastic musical act with a distinct sound all their own. If you're really into this type of music, you'll know that Justice's music is often entirely different from anything Daft Punk ever produced.
With or without Daft Punk, "Grand Theft Auto VI" is shaping up to be one of the biggest and most ambitious pieces of art ever created. That's probably why it was delayed so many times . Audio presentation has been critical to "Grand Theft Auto" since 2002's "Vice City" created an entire radio ecosystem comprised of licensed songs from the 1980s. Based on what we've seen (or heard) from "Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album" and the radio station previews released online, "GTA 6" will proudly continue that esteemed tradition. Still, there's no harm in wondering what could have been.

articles.chapeau: Cyberleek posted a three-part End of the road message on Oct 14, 2026, ending its GTA 6 leak campaign without a PC build or spoilers.
articles.txt:
Cyberleek, the anonymous account behind months of Grand Theft Auto VI leaks, says it is done. On October 14, 2026, the leaker posted a three-part message titled “End of the road,” announcing it will not release a full game build, will not post the game’s ending, and does not plan further early gameplay leaks. The post marks the clearest signal yet that the long-running GTA 6 leak saga, which has rattled Rockstar Games and parent company Take-Two Interactive for the better part of a year, may finally be winding down.
Whether that holds is a separate question. Cyberleek has reversed course before, and nothing in the latest message can be independently verified beyond the post itself. Still, the announcement reframes a leak campaign that previously threatened to dump an entire playable build onto torrent sites. Instead, the leaker is walking away, at least for now, while keeping a handful of final-mission clips online as what it calls proof of access.

According to the October 14 post, Cyberleek broke its farewell statement into three distinct parts. The first addressed the fate of the alleged full game build, the second covered the ending and story content, and the third offered a handful of final clips described as proof rather than spoilers. Kotaku reported on the message under the headline “GTA 6 Leaker Announces They Won’t Release The Full Game” , framing it as the leaker calling a stop to the campaign, at least for the time being.
Cyberleek had previously floated a conditional threat: if a crypto token tied to the account hit a $30 million market cap, the full build would go out, story mode included, all the way to the credits. In its own words from that earlier post, “Here’s the deal, nice and clean. CYBERLEEK hits 30 million marketcap, the build goes out, full story mode, played to the end, credits and all,” as Gadgets360 reported at the time. That target was never reached, and the October 14 message closes the loop on it.
Cyberleek’s stated reasoning centers on risk versus reward. Uploading hundreds of gigabytes of a stolen build anonymously carries real exposure, and the leaker framed the payoff as only worth it if the crypto milestone had funded whatever project sat behind the threat. With the target missed, the math apparently stopped working. The account has made no claim about a PC build timeline, pricing, or file size beyond what it has already posted, and none of those specifics are confirmed by any outlet covering the story.
This is a notable shift from the tone Cyberleek struck in earlier posts, which read more like negotiation tactics aimed at Take-Two than a farewell. Eurogamer covered the escalation at the time the full-build threat first surfaced, and the contrast between that posture and the October 14 retreat is stark. Readers can track the earlier claim in shattered.io’s own coverage of Cyberleek’s 200GB “playable” build claim , which laid out the scope of what the leaker said it was holding.
The second part of the message dealt specifically with the game’s ending, and it’s arguably the most consequential piece of the whole statement. Cyberleek claims to have access to the conclusion of GTA 6’s story but says it will not publish it. In its own words, reported by Kotaku, “CL has the ending. It was considered. It would punish Take-Two greatly, but ruin the experience for the gamers, who did nothing wrong. Take-Two would show CL no mercy, why should CL show any to them? Still: Take-Two was punished enough. The ending stays unpublished.”

The threat has since fizzled: on October 14, 2026, Cyberleek said the $30 million cryptocurrency target had not been reached and that it would not release the alleged full build, so the claimed 200GB build remains unreleased and unverified.
